match-card.score-hint: Cosine similarity between your query and this person's best-matching record (−1 to 1). A ranking signal, not a probability.
match-card.external-hint: Appears as a co-author in ZORA but is not recorded as UZH-affiliated.
match-card.counts: {publications, plural, =0 {No matching publications} one {# matching publication} other {# matching publications}} · {postings, plural, =0 {no thesis postings} one {# thesis posting} other {# thesis postings}}
match-card.evidence: Records this match is based on

recommendation-panel.title: Recommendation
recommendation-panel.loading-hint: With an LLM configured this can take up to a minute.
recommendation-panel.note: Synthesised from the same retrieval. Without an LLM, the matcher writes this list from a template.

unreachable.title: Matcher not reachable
unreachable.body: The matcher did not answer, or it failed with a server error (those reach the browser without CORS headers). Check that it runs with CORS enabled for this origin, and look at its log:

index-not-built.title: No index yet
index-not-built.body: The matcher has no search index, so there is nothing to match against. Build one first.

index-run-in-progress.title: Index run in progress
index-run-in-progress.body: Run #{{runId}} is still indexing. Only one run can hold the index at a time.

database-unavailable.title: Database not answering
database-unavailable.body: The matcher is up, but its Postgres database did not respond. Try again in a moment.

validation.title: Request rejected
validation.body: The matcher did not accept the request. The query must not be empty.

not-found.title: Not found
not-found.body: The matcher does not know this entry.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: The matcher returned an unexpected error.

home.title: Finding the right supervisor match for you.

describe.title: Describe
describe.body: Write the work you want to do in plain language. No keywords, no faculty codes, no reading lists.

retrieve.title: Retrieve
retrieve.body: THEMIS reads publication records from ZORA and open thesis postings across the departments, then ranks them against your query.

shortlist.title: Shortlist
shortlist.body: You get a ranked shortlist of supervisors, research groups and concrete thesis positions — each one shown with the records it matched on.

preview.title: Theme preview
preview.subtitle: The controls the matcher features will be built from.
preview.query-label: What would you like to work on?
preview.query-placeholder: e.g. a master's thesis in NLP on retrieval-augmented generation
preview.coming-soon: Matching, recommendations and the index panel arrive with the next features. This card only previews the theme.

search.title: Describe the thesis you have in mind.
search.query-label: What would you like to work on?
search.query-placeholder: e.g. a master's thesis in NLP on retrieval-augmented generation
search.query-hint: Plain language works best. Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to search.

idle.title: Nothing searched yet
idle.body: Enter a query or pick an example. You get ranked supervisors with their matching records, and a written recommendation next to them.

matches.title: Ranked supervisors
matches.loading-hint: The first query after the matcher starts also loads the embedding model, which takes a while.

empty.title: No matches
empty.body: Nobody in the index matched this query. Try describing it differently.
